about_the_game:
This program is the free-to-play prologue version of Realm of Ink, where players will control the female protagonist, wield three different weapons, break through the scroll, and reclaim destiny!

Ink landscapes, swords shattering scrolls.
"Realm of Ink: Prologue" features complete localization in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English, with a gameplay duration of approximately 15 to 20 minutes.
In the prologue, there are over 10 NPC characters with whom players will interact.
In the prologue, players can experience the core action-packed gameplay of the entire game.
Within the book, a universe unfolds; within the mystical pages, there lie hidden realms.
Red, the swordswoman, seeks freedom through countless twists and turns, searching for the path to unlock the book.

Exciting Action
A thrilling action system with a diverse array of combat moves. Move freely, command effortlessly.

Rich Gameplay
The core gameplay mechanics consist of Ink Gems, Perks, level selection, and Meta Progression.

Varied Items
Combine over a dozen Ink Gems, with yin and yang in harmony; dozens of Perks provide different passive effects. Endless combinations for limitless gameplay.
